title: A twin journey seen through received signals
promptMarkdown: A traveller leaves Earth at $4c/5$ and turns around at Earth-frame time 5 years, instantly taking velocity $-4c/5$, then returns at time 10 years. Use $c=1$ with years/light-years. Find the traveller's age, the Earth times assigned simultaneous with turnaround in the outgoing and incoming frames, and the time Earth first receives a signal emitted at turnaround. If the traveller emits pulses at fixed proper-time intervals small compared with a year, find the received frequency relative to the emission frequency before and after the turnaround signal. Reconcile all descriptions without saying an Earth clock physically jumps.
hintLadder: Use the same turnaround event in both Lorentz time transformations.
An emitted signal travels 4 light-years back to Earth.
Derive reception spacing as emission spacing plus the change in light-travel time.
